Körningen eller koncernjournalen stämmer: The run or the group ledger does not match its checksums. Do not use the figures, and contact whoever runs NONOX.
En intern sammanställd resultaträkning o: An internal compiled income statement and balance sheet for the group from a stored consolidation, with the eliminations from the group ledger. As CSV and PDF, always labelled as an internal group report.
Rapporterna visar en sparad konsoliderin: The reports show a stored consolidation: the companies' own books summed after the group's account map, with the eliminations accepted in the group ledger for the same period. They are internal material, not group accounts, and nothing is booked in any of the companies.
Rapporterna bygger på körningarna i körl: The reports are built on the runs in the run log. Run a new consolidation under Consolidation to include what has been booked or eliminated since.
Företagen är företagens egen bokföring f: The companies is the companies' own books for the days they belong to the group, summed after the account map. Eliminations is the group ledger entries the run applied. The group is the sum of both.
Rapporterna bygger på en sparad konsolid: The reports are built on a stored consolidation. Make a run under Consolidation and it is shown here.
Den visas inte heller för den som inte f: Nor is it shown to anyone who may not see reports in every company the run read, for example a company that has left the group since.
